This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="One Warrior to Another" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their varying shades of [[Color|blue]] scaly-like skin. They had rounded heads with spikes extending from the backs of their [[Bone|cranium]]s, their faces featuring large [[eye]]s with large black pupils and gold irises, as well as exposed [[Nose|nostrils]] and wideset pointed [[Tooth|teeth]]. They spoke an [[alien]] [[language]].<ref name="One Warrior to Another" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Members of this species could be found on an [[Unidentified desert world|unidentified world]] near a location known as [[Cipher Canyon]]. They were mistaken as raiders by local settlers, though in reality they were simply attempting to protect their local resources from being taken without permission. These members of this species generally donned full body [[armor]], and rode [[speeder bike]]s. [[Asajj Ventress]], [[Lyco Strata]], and a [[Unidentified granddaughter|young girl]] encountered this group when attempting to gather [[water]] from the canyon, briefly coming into conflict before agreeing to make peace with they and the girl's [[Unidentified grandfather (Asajj Ventress)|grandfather]] who lived nearby. Afterwards, members of the species pointed Ventress and Strata towards the secret meeting point of the [[Hidden Path]].<ref name="One Warrior to Another" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[One Warrior to Another|third episode]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'',<ref name="One Warrior to Another" /> which aired on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref>
